# Thirteenth pass (generated by scripts/make_stats_p20.py; pre-registered in LOG.md)

Real occlusion with hole-robust labels; four detectors per backbone scored in one job on the same points. A cell counts for the gate when the unobserved share averages at least 0.5%; in it the claim holds if the DTU-trained label-free head beats the aligned perturbation variance (K = 8) at p < 0.05 (paired sign-flip over scenes). Reprojection with the model's own cameras is reported with the same test and no rule.
